dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides several expert‑level heuristics (e.g., execution‑role PassRole gotcha, cache‑key composition with image digests, DAG vs list order) that a baseline model would miss, but the majority of the content restates official documentation rather than novel insight, so 4 points are deducted.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Delivers AWS‑specific step‑dependency reasoning, property‑reference DAG building, and concrete IAM checks. One procedure (role‑trust verification) is described in generic terms rather than the precise policy JSON order, costing a point.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a detailed NEVER list with concrete reasons (PassRole, caching assumptions, RegisterModel not deploying, etc.). Could include a few more pitfalls (e.g., VPC/subnet mis‑configurations), so 1 point is deducted.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description explains WHAT, WHEN, and includes keywords. Activation triggers are embedded in the description but not a dedicated front‑matter field, making automated discovery slightly less reliable; deduct 1 point.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The document layers high‑level summary, quick navigation, then deep technical sections, but the initial sections are dense and contain many details that could be deferred, causing some cognitive overload; deduct 2 points.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (pipeline creation) are tightly constrained by the literal output contract and prerequisite checks. Slightly lax on required naming constraints (e.g., uniqueness validation) loses one point.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable structure (Mindset, Heuristics, Steps, NEVER, Output), but the ordering of sections (e.g., mixing quick navigation before mindset) is a bit ad‑hoc, preventing a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides runnable code snippets, checklist, verification commands, and error‑handling guidance. Lacks explicit handling for a missing EventBridge invoke role and for ValidationException edge cases beyond a brief note, so an agent could stumble on those.
